data.name: Sea Star: The Diaries of Anne Bonny
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

Sea Star is a third-person, single-player action-adventure game that tells a parallel story of survival and legacy across two distinct eras. Players control Anne Bonny as both the legendary 18th-century pirate and her modern-day descendant.

Instead of maintaining a large, permanent arsenal of primary firearms, the gameplay forces you to rely on an improvisational combat loop. You carry only a permanent sidearm and a melee weapon, using a high-mobility grappling hook to yank primary weapons directly out of enemy hands, empty the magazines, throw the empty guns to stagger threats, and repeat the cycle.

The game transitions from a vibrant, vertical tropical island in the classic era to a dense, hostile jungle hub in the modern era. Sea Star blends fluid traversal, environmental puzzle-solving, and aggressive weapon-scavenging combat, backed by an original soundtrack composed by Beverly Van Wingerden.

Key Features

  • Engage in a fast-paced, improvisational combat loop where primary weapons cannot be reloaded, forcing you to constantly snatch firearms from enemies with your grapple hook and hurl them when empty to stagger your threats.

  • Navigate highly vertical environments by scaling massive outpost walls, swinging across deep sea coves, and dropping onto targets from the jungle canopy using a high-mobility grappling hook.

  • Experience an active dual-era parallelism where the tactical layouts and exploration mechanics of 18th-century pirate outposts directly mirror and inform your approach to modern military camps.

  • Explore two massive, wide-linear sandbox hub levels packed with fortified enemy camps to infiltrate and environmental puzzles that reward you with permanent gear upgrades.

  • Survive overwhelming group crossfire by throwing empty weapons to trigger a tactical stagger, forcing enemies to lose track of you so you can isolate a single foe or vanish back into the shadows.

data.short_description: Anne Bonny, the direct descendant of the infamous South Carolina namesake pirate, must choose to take on one of the world’s most notorious crime lords to save both the United States and the man she loves from atomic destruction.

content_descriptors.notes: Depictions of intense violence and strong language.
